description: RocketWright UI draft images; proposed features and sample values.

screens.title: 目的と条件の入力
screens.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Deliver one high-fidelity desktop web app UI draft, landscape 16:9, 1920x1080-style detail. Japanese interface for RocketWright, a friendly educational rocket concept-design simulator for ordinary people. This is an interface proposal, not actual engineering results. Include a discreet top-right 「UIドラフト / 表示例」 label. Use only short legible Japanese labels, meticulously aligned numbers and units.
Input image 1 is the official Zoo Design Studio screenshot, used ONLY as a visual/layout reference. Reproduce its sober neutral-dark CAD workbench structure closely: flat near-black #1e1e1e viewport, charcoal #2d2d2d slim headers, 1px gray separators, connected docked panels, small understated controls, minimal corner radii, compact normal-weight Japanese sans-serif. NO oversized wordmark, cyan glowing cards, prominent rounded metric tiles, generic AI-dashboard styling, gratuitous gradients, stars, HUD circles, sales slogans, dashboard hero or presentation framing.
One consistent application shell: slim top bar with small blue RW monogram and 「RocketWright」, project name 「egg-recovery / 案 A」; narrow far-left icon rail; left dock about 20% width for mission/parts/candidates/properties; central model or media workspace about 55%; right conversation/task dock about 23%; tiny bottom status bar. A compact toolbar floats along the top of the central workspace. Content meets the panel edges with subtle separators, no wide gutters. Dark panels remain almost monochrome, small blue active markers and a restrained mint action accent. Preserve the reference's calm purposeful density but use readable Japanese at normal app scale.
Shared mission for all drafts: an EDUCATIONAL WATER-BOTTLE ROCKET carrying a small egg-shaped payload, target height 30 m, payload 60 g, bottle 1.5 L, budget 3,000 円, parachute recovery. It is a benign classroom water-pressure demonstration. Proposed model appearance is consistent: clear PET bottle body, a simple dark blue rounded cap/nose, three small dark-blue stabilizing fins, a cream egg-payload capsule near the top, small packed recovery canopy. No engines or internal propulsion details. Main viewport model is a physically plausible clean miniature external model, not a missile or orbital launcher.
In all screens, the rocket and interface have a consistent recognizable silhouette and the same neutral dark styling. New distinctive feature: two or three original tiny 3D maintenance workers, each two-and-a-half-heads-tall proportions, muted mustard hard hat, gray overalls, small gloves and boots, simple friendly faces. They are miniature characters within the viewport, not giant avatars, not a known franchise, not emoji or stickers. Warmth comes from purposeful miniature work; the app chrome stays professional and quiet. Characters occupy roughly 3-5% of screen height, model roughly 45-60% of central view height. No exaggerated comic speech balloons.
All displayed costs, percentages and times in this draft are illustrative sample UI values. Don't imply a real verified design or a completed implementation. Show only one app screen, no phone/laptop frame, no collage, no captions outside the interface.
Input image 2 is the newly approved master draft of the analysis screen. Match its application shell, panel widths, typography, subtle blue selection, gray surfaces, SAME clear bottle and dark-blue nose/fins with cream egg capsule, SAME original tiny gray-overall mustard-helmet workers and miniature rendering style. Produce a different screen state of this SAME product, not a new visual design. Do not show the analysis state unless specifically asked below.
SCREEN 01 — MISSION INPUT AND CONDITION CONFIRMATION, before running analysis.
The right conversation panel is the user's main starting point. Heading 「設計の相談」, user text 「卵を30 mまで飛ばして、割らずに回収したい。」, assistant response 「条件を整理しました。内容を確認して、解析を始めましょう。」. Show four simple editable form rows, not separate cards: 「目標の高さ」 30 m; 「積載物」 卵 / 60 g; 「予算」 3,000 円; 「回収」 パラシュート. A small neutral secondary action 「条件を変更」. The bottom composer placeholder 「やりたいことを話してください…」. A clear normal-sized mint primary action 「この条件で解析」 near these confirmed inputs, not a giant banner. A subtle text field for bottle capacity 「ボトル容量 1.5 L」.
Left panel heading 「ミッション」 with a concise flat project tree 「卵の回収」「設計条件」「使用する部品」「設計案」. Under a separator, labeled properties summarize the target, mass, bottle and recovery. Blank candidate area should not invent completed designs. Top path 「egg-recovery / 条件の確認」.
Central canvas is largely quiet and open, with a faint thin-line ghost of the same water-bottle model hovering above a simple assembly base. No completed polished rocket and no finished results yet. Two tiny workers are waiting beside the base: one looks at a rolled-out blueprint, one leans on a small tool trolley. Retain the master's warm approachable little 3D figurines but make them secondary. A single modest label on the canvas 「条件を確認して、設計を始める」 with small supporting line 「機体の形と飛び方を一緒に検討します」, positioned calmly; no oversized hero typography. The viewport toolbar is mostly inactive and gray. At the bottom, an unframed workflow row 「条件の確認 → 設計・解析 → 比較 → 動画・出力」 with first stage selected using a thin blue underline. No fake analysis progress, no ETA before a job starts.
Show a usable, inviting first screen within the actual industrial workbench, with the right conversation and conditions as the clear main action.

SCREEN 02 — ANALYSIS IN PROGRESS. The central view shows the water-bottle model raised on a very small workshop platform with understated gray temporary scaffolding. One tiny worker on the platform checks the recovery capsule with a clipboard, another gently spreads a small folded parachute on a workbench, the third checks a fin using a little measuring tool. A small hanging work lamp and a wheeled tool trolley make the scene tangible. Limit construction props to the immediate model area; no large factory background. This is analysis visualization, not a claim that real hardware is being manufactured.
Left dock heading 「解析の工程」 with four plain vertically stacked rows: 「部品構成」 check complete, 「飛行高度」 check complete, 「風と回収」 active, 「候補の比較」 waiting. Under a separator show 「解析対象」 then 「回収装置 / 機体全体」, followed by compact mission fields 「目標 30 m」「積載 60 g」「予算 3,000 円」. No progress percentage for the whole open-ended search.
At the bottom of the central viewport, an elegant integrated unframed status strip contains highly readable 「風による回収のばらつきを確認中」, 「72 / 100 条件」, 「経過 1分12秒」, 「この工程の残り 約20〜40秒」, and a thin factual 72-of-100 segmented progress indicator. Above the model, a small tag 「解析中」. Keep this strip visually restrained with no thick colorful border. A little worker location corresponds to the recovery section highlight, a low-opacity blue technical selection on the upper capsule rather than a huge glowing cloud.
Right panel heading 「設計の相談」; show the user's short mission 「卵を30 mまで飛ばして、割らずに回収したい。」 and one concise agent message 「風の条件を変えて、回収できる範囲を確認しています。」. Below it put quiet actual task lines 「完了 72件」「実行中 4件」. Lower-right usable controls 「動きを止める」 and 「解析を中断」, bottom composer 「追加したい条件を書く…」. The overall impression is a real precise CAD app with a small charming maintenance crew, not a mobile game.

SCREEN 03 — ANALYSIS COMPLETE / COMPARE TWO DESIGN PROPOSALS.
Keep the same dark CAD workbench. Left heading 「設計案」. Two flat selectable tree rows 「案 A 回収を優先」 selected in a muted blue rectangle and 「案 B 費用を優先」 unselected. Below, the expanded selected model's component tree 「回収カプセル」「ボトル」「フィン」「パラシュート」 and a few compact dimensions/properties. Completed analysis steps collapse into 「解析の記録」.
Central viewport is dominated by the SAME completed clear water-bottle model with dark-blue rounded nose, three blue fins and cream egg capsule. The scaffolding is removed. Two small workers at the bottom are tidying tools and giving a quiet thumbs up; they do not obscure the model. The 3D geometry and shading must match the master. A small status label 「解析完了」 rather than a giant celebration. No confetti.
A shallow bottom docking area, around 25% of the central column's height, shows a clean comparison table with columns 「案 A 回収を優先」「案 B 費用を優先」 and rows 「到達高度」「概算費用」「試行成功率」. Illustrative values A 「29.6 m」「2,300 円」「94 / 100」; B 「30.8 m」「1,900 円」「86 / 100」. All fictional layout samples, covered by the persistent top 「UIドラフト / 表示例」 label. Keep table typography readable and precise, align units, selected A in a low-opacity blue column with plain 「選択中」. Add a compact 「飛行結果を見る」 link. Avoid KPI cards or floating giant figures.
Right conversation panel: heading 「設計の相談」. Concise summary 「案 A は回収を優先し、案 B は費用を抑えています。どちらを採用しますか？」. Below, three plain lines display selected A's key values. A comfortably sized primary action 「この案を採用」 and secondary 「条件を変えて再解析」. Bottom composer 「案の違いについて相談する…」. Preserve calm empty space rather than filling every area with cards.
Top project path 「egg-recovery / 案 A」; center toolbar tabs 「機体」「寸法図」「飛行結果」. The screen must make selected design, tradeoff and next action instantly apparent.

Produce a different screen state of this SAME product, not a new visual design. Do not show the analysis state unless specifically asked below.
SCREEN 04 — SELECTED DESIGN / EXPLANATION VIDEO, LAUNCH CG AND DOWNLOADS.
Retain the exact same neutral-dark CAD app shell and project 「egg-recovery / 案 A」. This is a proposal for future output functionality, indicated only by persistent 「UIドラフト / 表示例」.
Left dock heading 「成果物」, a simple file tree with small outline icons and rows 「展示用模型 STL」「模型 3MF」「設計図 PDF」「部品表 CSV」「設計データ JSON」「設計解説 MP4」「打ち上げ CG MP4」. Label selected design and revision simply 「案 A / v03」. Do not make it a marketplace or a file-card gallery.
Central workspace contains two unmistakable video previews in a stacked unframed editorial arrangement within one app screen:
- Upper/main player about 60% of central content height, heading 「設計の解説」. It shows the SAME clear water-bottle model inside a neutral small studio/workshop, semi-exploded view with its egg recovery capsule and blue fins separated a little along the central axis. Sophisticated restrained technical text overlays label only 「回収カプセル」「フィン」「パラシュート」 with thin leader lines, an unobtrusive play triangle and normal player seek bar 「00:04 / 00:12」. Use the 3D-plus-HUD explanatory-video look without glowing dashboard ornamentation. One tiny familiar worker with clipboard stands beside the model, not as a presenter covering the screen.
- Lower secondary player, heading 「打ち上げ CG」, shows a photorealistic CG close shot of the SAME educational bottle lifting off from a simple water-rocket stand in an empty grassy school demonstration field under natural daylight; the bottle's cap and fins are dark blue and an egg capsule is visible. A visible short spray of WATER, no combustion flames or smoke. A cinematic low-angle camera, believable sun and soft depth of field. Empty field, no crowd. This is a simulation visualization. Include a little play control and 「00:00 / 00:10」.
Right dock heading 「動画と出力」. Two plain status rows 「設計解説 完了」「打ち上げ CG 完了」 with small checkmarks, then normal compact outlined buttons 「解説を再生」「打ち上げ CG を再生」「動画を保存」. Under a separator show 「モデルと図面」 and normal download controls 「模型を保存」「設計図を保存」. A modest info line 「すべて案 A / v03 のデータから作成」. A collapsible neutral row 「生成の記録」. Bottom small chat composer 「構造や飛び方について相談する…」. No invented live launch controls, no claim of real-world hardware certification.
Overall this is an appealing but credible engineering-tool results page where a user can understand their design, enjoy its simulated flight, and take away its files. Strong model continuity across both players and the master reference is essential.
